items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent failed standard opening branding ('Mobile technical queries...') and closing branding.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Nathan throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand the intense panic and fury this is causing with your mortgage settlement at stake today, Nathan...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent paraphrased the SMS issue accurately.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for mobile number at turn 42 despite customer stating 07700 900612 at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent guided customer through SMSC reconfiguration, dispatched test message, and waived line rental charge.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent insulted customer at turn 11: 'If you keep entering the wrong verification codes into your banking app, the bank blocks your account; that isn't our network's fault.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked about messaging app spam filters and error messages.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Test SMS did not arrive on call and customer was advised to wait 2-24 hours for carrier propagation.
